reason: A DSH agent preset and plugin focused primarily on persistent cross-session memory, reusable skill learning, historical session search, and related agent context management.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 编码智能体提供跨会话记忆、可复用技能学习、历史会话搜索和上下文注入能力。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness coding agents with cross-session memory, reusable skill learning, historical session search, and prompt context injection.

capabilities: Persists agent memories across sessions and restarts
Automatically summarizes and injects remembered preferences, facts, conventions, and corrections into prompts
Distills nontrivial workflows into reusable persistent skills
Searches historical sessions, events, and lineage
Combines multiple tool calls into a TypeScript program through Code Mode
